description: This file provides utilities for HTTP requests, including request creation, execution with retries, request/response dumping, and support for file uploads with chunking and retries. It further defines structures and methods for handling file upload jobs and workers, particularly for uploading large files in parts over HTTP with backoff retries.

classes.name: HTTPHelper
classes.description: A helper class encapsulating HTTP client, endpoint, and authentication details for making various types of HTTP requests, dumping requests and responses for debugging, and managing request creation.

classes.name: HTTPRequestBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing and executing HTTP requests with additional features like retries and JSON decoding.

classes.name: FilesUploader
classes.description: A utility class for uploading multiple files, supporting chunk uploads, retries, and concurrent worker management.

classes.name: uploadChunkJob
classes.description: Represents a job to upload a specific chunk of a file, including filename, chunk number, total chunks, and chunk size.

classes.name: uploadChunkWorker
classes.description: Worker class for processing uploadChunkJobs, handling multipart request creation, retries with backoff, and HTTP upload operations.

methods.name: NewGetRequest
methods.description: Constructs a new GET HTTP request for the helper's endpoint.

methods.name: NewDeleteRequest
methods.description: Constructs a new DELETE HTTP request for the helper's endpoint.

methods.name: NewPostRequest
methods.description: Constructs a new POST HTTP request with a JSON body for the helper.

methods.name: NewUploadFileRequest
methods.description: Creates a PUT request with a file body for uploading files with context.

methods.name: dumpRequest
methods.description: Dumps the HTTP request for debugging purposes.

methods.name: dumpResponse
methods.description: Dumps the HTTP response for debugging purposes.

methods.name: AddHeader
methods.description: Adds a header to the HTTP request.

methods.name: SetHeader
methods.description: Sets a header value in the HTTP request.

methods.name: SetBasicAuth
methods.description: Sets Basic Authentication headers on the request.

methods.name: Do
methods.description: Executes the HTTP request without retries.

methods.name: JSONResDo
methods.description: Executes the request expecting a JSON response to be decoded into provided variable.

methods.name: JSONResDoWithRetries
methods.description: Executes request with retries, decoding JSON response into provided variable.

methods.name: setAuthz
methods.description: Sets Authorization headers on request based on available tokens.

methods.name: doWithRetries
methods.description: Executes HTTP request with specified retry options, handling retries on specified status codes.

methods.name: isIn
methods.description: Checks if a status code is within a list of status codes.

methods.name: getFilesInfos
methods.description: Generates info structs for provided file paths, including total chunks based on size.

methods.name: sendJobs
methods.description: Dispatches upload jobs for all file chunks.

methods.name: startWorkers
methods.description: Starts worker goroutines to process upload jobs with backoff retries.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Returns a channel of errors for each upload chunk processed by a worker.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Performs the upload of a specific file chunk with retries and backoff.

methods.name: writeMultipartRequest
methods.description: Prepares and writes multipart data for a given file chunk to a multipart writer.

methods.name: addFormField
methods.description: Adds a form field to a multipart writer.
